tools.description: Stage A development-only control: synchronously executes at most one locally owned pending task, mutating task outcomes and occupancy. Installed market executors run bounded real-source paths when an inspected official snapshot env is installed and record SOURCE_NOT_VERIFIED otherwise; stopping inspections may interrupt proven never-started tasks; started or unsupported executions retain their claims with insufficient evidence. Publication inspections record fixed durable evidence without changing original tasks. It never downloads market data or forcibly unlocks original tasks. Not a background scheduler or production pipeline.

tools.description: Stage A SQLite development-only task control. Read the actual request_id binding and task state without accepting work.
tools.name: get_request

tools.description: Owner-only bounded management of an abnormal verification task, not a recursive asynchronous task. Each reliably persisted result, including insufficient evidence, consumes request_id; the same ID replays its historical result without re-inspecting. A new ID is needed for fresh evidence. Checks registered local execution exclusion and durable finish separately; may close only the verification task, never the original business task or its claims. Missing/unregistered runtime proof retains protection. No force/evidence flags, waiting, implicit retry or production source approval.

inputSchema.description: No caller-supplied proof, force flag, actor or clock.

RequestTerminal.description: Untagged wrapper preserves the existing stopped-result wire shape.

tools.description: Explicit asynchronous inspection of durable publication evidence for an unresolved market task. Reads fixed SQLite publication versions, receipts and projections; missing receipt is insufficient evidence, not proof of failure. The separate check never publishes, changes heads or releases the original task claims. A prior all-recorded conclusion can bind a new request without a new inspection. Inspect publication_check via get_task_progress. Corrupt evidence and interrupted inspections retain protection; no caller approval or force flags. This ready interface does not make the official data source production-ready.
tools.name: verify_publication_result

RequestTerminal.description: Untagged wrapper preserves the existing stopped-result wire shape.

tools.description: Explicit asynchronous stopping-evidence inspection of a task awaiting verification. Admission preserves original claims. The installed verifier can prove an audited revision-zero task never started using verified SQLite facts and conditional exclusion of a later claim. Started or unsupported executions remain STOP_EVIDENCE_NOT_VERIFIED; no caller assertion, PID absence or old run identity can unlock a task. Inspect the separate check conclusion via get_task_progress.
tools.name: verify_stopped_writes

RequestTerminal.description: Untagged wrapper preserves the existing stopped-result wire shape.

tools.description: Explicit asynchronous verification of a proven local coverage gap in one published QFQ daily version. The caller names only symbol/day/[start,end]; the subject head is frozen at acceptance and re-checked at decision commit. Decisions come only from the installed trusted source-gap verifier; source limitation or unavailability never produces a proven gap, and a decision never triggers update/backfill by itself. The installed production verifier is blocked (GAP_BASIS_NOT_VERIFIED) until the source gates lift.

VerifyGapTarget.description:
Which day range of which symbol to verify. `period` is a closed enum:
`year` (or anything else) fails decode — yearly stays derived.

tools.description: Explicit market.daily ranges or market.yearly natural-year sets, each bound to a published daily version; market.daily also accepts selection {"kind":"default"}, resolved and frozen from the acceptance snapshot (catalog + started securities + published heads + open proven gaps). Yearly publication mode and comparison are explicit and frozen; historical mode never advances head. Automatic gap discovery and catalog updates are not implemented. With an installed inspected official snapshot the worker executes bounded real-source explicit-range updates and default frozen-gap backfills; without one it fails closed. Publish gating via PRODUCTION_BLOCKERS remains.
